Slots #2, #1, #3, #4, #5, #6, #7 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #3 ranks 3 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.001 R/G.
Slot #2 yields 4.59 expected PA/game vs 4.48 at primary slot #3. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
